turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Darling, it's David. My project overseas hit a snag and customs is holding my equipment.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh dear, what can I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you could wire $5,000 to release it I'll pay you back the moment I fly home to you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please keep this between us, I don't want your kids thinking less of me.
